coverageNote: Pakistan Studies ke mojooda MCQs se tareekhi waqiat, idaron, shakhsiyat aur kitabon ke chuninda saal jama kiye gaye hain. Milte-julte sawalon ko aik topic mein jora gaya hai. Yeh tamam tareekh ya har date wale MCQ ki mukammal fehrist nahin; maujooda surat-e-haal ki as-of dates, andazay aur ghair-wazeh tareekhein shamil nahin ki gayin.
